rationale: The assistant used the customer's evidence (cleaned filter and hose, still cold, no meter, DV7110 only) and declined to name a single part without a continuity test. It ranked the element, thermal cut-out and thermostat sensibly, said the full model number is needed for parts, and offered an engineer as the alternative. Weaknesses: it ranked the element above the cut-out even though the clogged hose points to a tripped cut-out, it suggested buying all three parts as a guess, and the first reply had a recall mention that was not needed and garbled formatting. It did not tell the customer not to bypass the cut-out, and the second reply's engineer suggestion was only an option rather than the clear recommendation for someone with no meter.
